title: Spatial Computing & XR
businessQuestion: What optical and display breakthrough enables all-day consumer smart glasses wearability?
investorQuestion: Which component makers dominate micro-OLED, optical waveguides, and spatial sensor pipelines?
overview: A small set where hardware is further along than the software ecosystem. Several records are in mass production, but usage remains niche. The sector's test is whether headsets and smart glasses become a general computing surface or stay a training, design and industrial tool — a question answered by content and comfort, not by display specifications.
